Prop Variations

105 new variations of the 21 scenery props of Red Canyon, five each. None of them is in the game yet.

Go through them and answer by name: “add Old Giant, forget Lone Spear”. Anything you do not mention stays out.

Every picture stands on the game's sand colour. A green in the game tag marks what a map already places: it is here for comparison only. A red weak tag marks one that came out poorly on both tries; it is listed anyway.
